bio.text: Michael Alfonso, a Republican, won the August 2026 Republican primary for Wisconsin's open 7th Congressional District seat, according to the Wisconsin Examiner's primary voter guide, which marks him as the winning candidate.
The Examiner describes him as a Wisconsin native and University of Wisconsin-Madison graduate who says he worked in the construction industry while in college.
According to the Examiner's general election guide, Alfonso has worked as a producer on a podcast.
